name: Takaga Koi no Kuse ni
source:
Rookie illustrator Nishina Uruha finds herself sharing a large house with five people, male and female.

A love triangle of adult muddiness ensues at the share house.

What is the "fair argument of love" that lies beyond the tears shed by each of them?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ335142.html/?unique_op=af&utm_medium=affiliate&utm_source=vndb.org%2F]DLSite[/url]]
translation:
新人插画师仁科润羽开始与五位男女在一栋大房子里共同生活。

合租屋中展开了一场属于成年人的泥沼般的三角恋。

在各自流下的泪水之后，等待着他们的“爱的正论”究竟是什么？
